
# Prioritisation Approach

Functionality was prioritised using five criteria:

| Criterion            | Description                                    |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| User Demand          | Number of user groups requiring the capability |
| Strategic Importance | Alignment with project outcomes                |
| Technical Dependency | Required before later functionality            |
| Feasibility          | Delivery within available resources            |
| Reusability          | Applicability across ecosystems                |

Priority decisions were informed by workshop feedback, user stories, project deliverables and partner discussions.

This creates a rationale for your roadmap.
